Nivel de vechime: Asociat

We are looking for a skilled Software Tester with French skills to join our team. 
 What you'll need to know and do: 
 Organiser les Tests: Etablir/Rédiger la Stratégie de Recette; Definir les Critères de GO/NOGO; Concevoir les Macros-Test/Plan
 Concevoir/Analyser les Tests: Etablir les Campagnes / Scénarios; Rediger/Documenter les Cas de Tests; Valoriser les Cas de Tests
 Executer les Tests: Réaliser les Tests (passages des cas de tests…); Tests Fonctionnels; Tests de Bout en Bout / TAU; Tests d'Intrusions; Declarer les Dysfonctionnements/Problèmes/Anomalies
 Piloter et Suivre les Tests: Faire la synthèse de l'Avancement; Faire la synthèse des Anomalies; Construire et Communiquer les Reportings
 Conclure: Organiser le GO/NOGO; Décider du GO/NOGO; Mettre à niveau la documentation (anomalies/Bilan de Recette…); Rediger le PV de Recette.
 Hybrid work with 3 days in the office in either Bucharest/Timisoara/Cluj/Brasov 
 Why should you join us? 
We have a solid company (projects that last minimum one year), and employees stay with us on average for about 10 years
We have many projects (50+) and lots of career opportunities. After you finish your first project, for the next one you can choose to master the skills that you already know, or learn new technologies on the next one. This way, you do not have to change the company, just the project
Reimbursement of agreed certifications
Private medical subscription
Team buildings.
